usage: main.py [-h] {smart,decompress,compare}

Smart Compression CLI: choose smart compression, restoration, or comparison.

positional arguments:
  {smart,decompress,compare}
                        Operation to run

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

Commands:
  smart       Predict one codec and save a verified compressed package.
  decompress  Restore a saved package and verify its size and SHA-256.
  compare     Measure all four codecs and report mode-specific scores.

Use main.py COMMAND --help for that command's input and options.

usage: main.py smart [-h] --mode {archive,balanced,fast_access}
                     --model {decision_tree,random_forest}
                     [--model-dir MODEL_DIR] --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                     input

Select from pre-compression features, then compress with one saved model's
choice. Only load trusted, locally generated model directories: pickle hashes
detect accidental changes, but do not make an untrusted pickle safe to
execute.

positional arguments:
  input                 Non-empty input file

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --mode {archive,balanced,fast_access}
  --model {decision_tree,random_forest}
  --model-dir MODEL_DIR
                        Trusted model directory; defaults to saved Pilot
                        models
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        New directory for payload and manifest

usage: main.py decompress [-h] --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR package_dir

Restore a Smart Mode package into a new directory, checking both SHA-256s.
Uses the saved algorithm only. No model, feature extraction, benchmark, or
memory measurement is needed. Reads whole files into memory, as
smart_compress.py does.

positional arguments:
  package_dir           Smart Mode directory containing manifest.json and
                        payload

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        New directory for the restored original file

usage: main.py compare [-h] --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR input

Compare four codecs on one non-empty file using protocol-v2 timing and scores.
Reports only: no compressed package, model prediction, training, or memory
measurement. Raw repeat ns and measured medians are separate from mode labels.

positional arguments:
  input                 Non-empty input file to benchmark with all four codecs

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        New directory for comparison reports
